name: Muv-Luv Girls Garden
description:
About This Game

Over 800,000 copies sold across the series — the latest title in the Muv-Luv franchise!

Conquer the underground abyss known as the "Maze," where the laws of reality are distorted. Become an amnesiac commander and lead girls piloting humanoid machines called "MGs" in this full-auto idle RPG.

Deep beneath the earth lies a world where reason itself is distorted.

Gravity runs wild, and life descends into abominable, monstrous forms.

Once you set foot within it, you are consumed by an eternal abyss—its name is the Maze.

An amnesiac Commander, and girls chosen by fate.

Still, they head into the Maze.

Bound by a curse called hope.

But they do not yet know:

that this world, too, is an abyss;

and that this world itself is the answer to a distant “question”—

The latest title in the Muv-Luv series, with over 800,000 copies sold worldwide!
A full-auto idle RPG adventure alongside a cast of girls — Muv-Luv Girls Garden.

【Game Introduction】

Become an amnesiac commander who returned alive from the mysterious underground cavern known as the Maze.

Lead the girls of Zar'tum Academy, who pilot giant humanoid machines called "Maze Guarders (MG)," and uncover the truth of the world.

■ Zar'tum Academy
A vast academy city that is more than just an educational institution, where talents from every field—academics, arts, sports, and more—gather.

With residential districts, commercial areas, and even factory zones, it has the capacity for independent self-governance.

At its heart lies the Pilot Department—a place where challengers to the underground world known as the Maze gather.

■ The Maze
A mysterious, gigantic underground space stretching beneath Zar'tum Island.

Its full extent remains largely unexplored.

Countless unknown threats caused by gravitational anomalies await inside, while its origins remain shrouded in mystery.

It is also where the immensely valuable resource known as Tatsumiya Ore lies dormant.

■ Maze Guarder (MG)
A giant humanoid machine: the Maze Guarder—commonly known as MG (Maze Guarder).

Developed for mining Tatsumiya Ore, this machine has the high mobility needed to adapt to the complex terrain of the Maze.

It is also equipped to counter unknown threats, allowing it to handle a wide range of situations within the Maze.

【Featuring an All-Star Creative Team】

  • Worldbuilding Reconstruction: Hayato Tashiro

  • Main Character Design: Siino / Pro-p

  • Mechanical Redesign: Wataru Inada

While inheriting the soul of Muv-Luv, a completely new story now begins.
